name: Announcement
description: A one-line notice above the header (sale, event, changed hours) with an optional link. The visitor closes it with no JS (an open <details> whose summary is the close button); the dismissal is not remembered across pages.

tone.description: Background of the bar, from the theme tokens.

href.label: Link
href.description: Where the notice points (the sale, the event page).

linkLabel.label: Link label
linkLabel.description: Text of the link; defaults to "Learn more".

closeLabel.description: Accessible name of the close control (ui:).

a11y: The close control is a native <summary>: focusable, toggled with Enter or Space, and named by closeLabel. The link is a real link. The accent tone keeps full-contrast text.
